html:
Vietlook Travel will share with you The latest full Ha Giang travel experience Ha Giang tourist attractions, resorts, mountain passes, villages hidden in the mist, or the immense beauty of the flower seasons.

So, do you know all about the beauty of Ha Giang? If not, let’s explore the most charming beauty of this land with Vietlook Travel today – A beauty that cannot be found anywhere else.

1. Means of transport to Ha Giang?

Ha Giang has a winding, steep and dangerous road, if you take a Ha Giang tour from Hanoi, the distance is about 300 km. It takes you about 7-10 hours to get to Ha Giang.

If you take a Ha Giang Sapa tour, this distance is shorter than the Hanoi Ha Giang tour, about 200 km. However, you can still get here by bus, car or motorbike.

Bus and car to travel to Ha Giang

This is the safest means of transport chosen by many tourists, or you can rent a private car if you know the road you can drive yourself, or hire a private driver, if you hire a private driver it will be safe for you. Your travel time is about more than 10 hours.

On the way to Ha Giang, the car will stop for tourists to eat on the way and enjoy the scenery, in addition, you can rent a bus or motorbike. When you arrive in Ha Giang, you can rent a motorbike to travel around, and don’t forget to bring your ID.

Visiting Ha Giang by Motorbike

If you are an adventurous person, like to conquer the roads around the pass, you can choose to ride a motorbike to be free throughout the journey. Ha Giang motorbike tour is also very interesting, you should try it!

Here are some suggested routes from Hanoi to Ha Giang that you can refer to: After arriving in Ha Giang, you can rent a motorbike or join a group tour to explore Ha Giang.

Normally, tourists will choose to take a bus to Ha Giang the night before, sleep on the bus and arrive in Ha Giang at around 5 am the next morning. When arriving in Ha Giang, you can have breakfast and then rent a motorbike to go around from Ha Giang to Dong Van, Meo Vac, Lung Cu Flagpole and return to Yen Minh before returning to Ha Giang city.

Every route around Ha Giang will bring you one surprise after another. Because the route from Ha Giang to Dong Van passes through most of the beautiful tourist attractions.

You can also hire a bus to take many people from Hanoi straight to Dong Van (have lunch in Ha Giang city), but if you do so, you will miss many beautiful scenes of Ha Giang on the way and not see everything.

2. When is the best time to travel to Ha Giang?

Ha Giang has its own beauty and charm in each season, making it different from other seasons. If you are wondering which season is the best to visit Ha Giang, the answer is that any time is a good time and you can visit Ha Giang at any time of the year depending on your preferences. If you want to immerse yourself in buckwheat flowers and yellow Cai flowers, go at the end of the year. If you want to see peach blossoms, travel to Ha Giang in the spring…

Ha Giang Spring Tourism – Flower Season

In the spring, when you travel to Ha Giang, you will be amazed by the breathtaking beauty of blooming flowers. Cherry blossoms and other flowers cover the sky in white and pink, creating a beautiful natural picture among the high mountains.

Exploring the beautiful natural landscapes in Ha Giang in the spring also gives you the opportunity to experience unique cultural features with the local people. You can visit the highland markets, attend the Love Market and participate in traditional games with the locals during Tet.

From Quan Ba, Yen Minh, Dong Van to Meo Vac, there are many natural landscapes for you to explore. You can visit any place in Ha Giang and you will be overwhelmed by the natural beauty that nature has bestowed on Ha Giang, a very beautiful and charming land.

Summer – Water Season

Ha Giang in the water season is a destination chosen by many tourists. Coming here, visitors can immerse themselves in the beauty of terraced fields in the water season.

Discover the beautiful natural landscape in Ha Giang in the summer, Ha Giang is filled with images of golden sunlight spreading everywhere. And the rice fields are gradually turning green, creating a colorful and vibrant picture.

Traveling to Ha Giang in Autumn

Autumn has come to the rocky plateau of Ha Giang, which is also the time when many tourists love to admire the golden season. The heat of summer has been replaced by the image of golden rice fields, with buckwheat flowers starting to bloom across the mountainsides and valleys.

Ha Giang puts on a splendid coat, making many travelers’ footsteps flutter. The autumn color of Sung La is the place with the most charming buckwheat flowers, and is also a famous flower valley that challenges travelers’ footsteps to explore the wonders that nature has bestowed upon Ha Giang.

Traveling to Ha Giang in Winter

Winter has come to the Ha Giang plateau and you can feel the cold of the highlands. This season is also the time when adventure enthusiasts come to Ha Giang. Many roads are covered with white snow, many places in Ha Giang feel the cold, even snowfall. This is the best time for those who love adventure.

In addition, Ha Giang in winter also exudes a very sad and mysterious beauty of mountains, clouds, along with the image of mountains, fog and snowfall. Traveling to Ha Giang in this season, you can also enjoy the strong aroma of corn wine and buffalo meat, hot thang co dishes or grilled dishes…

3. Dong Van Stone Plateau

Spreading across 4 districts: Dong Van, Yen Minh, Quan Ba ​​and Meo Vac. In 2010, this place was recognized as a global geopark. Dong Van owns many beautiful natural landscape heritages, in addition, people also use unique stone fences to surround small houses, corn fields and vegetable gardens with a natural beauty like a painting.

Dong Van Ancient Town

An ancient town hidden in the gray rocky mountains. The ancient town is about 1 km long with about 40 houses built of unburnt bricks and ancient tiled roofs.

If you visit the ancient town on the full moon day, you will have the opportunity to immerse yourself in the festival atmosphere of the mountain town. With red lanterns hanging in front of the door and displaying local products such as colorful brocade, fragrant mint honey…

Or you can watch the process of making traditional dishes of ethnic minorities such as: “thang co”, “buckwheat cake”, “banh giay”…

Quan Ba ​​Twin Mountains

Quan Ba ​​Twin Mountains, the round and charming twin mountains resemble the full breasts of a sleeping mountain fairy. Coming here in the spring, visitors can immerse themselves in the spring colors of cherry blossoms, in the summer, the green rice fields, in the fall, the yellow color of ripe rice, and in the winter, the purple color of buckwheat flowers. You should visit Quan Ba ​​Heaven Gate. This is the best place to fully admire the beauty of these beautiful twin mountains.

The Meo King’s Palace

Built in the typical Mong architecture, mixed with Chinese and French architecture. The Meo King’s Palace is located on top of a small hill, with an entrance gate surrounded by two rows of tall, ancient pine trees. Inside the palace, there are many artifacts on display, reflecting the lavish and wealthy lifestyle of the king and his contemporaries.

Ma Pi Leng Pass – The majestic beauty of Ha Giang

The pass is known as the king of passes in Vietnam. With winding roads winding along the mountainside. On one side of the pass is a steep cliff, on the other side is a deep abyss, creating a challenging and breathtakingly exciting journey.

Located at an altitude of 1,200 meters, Ma Pi Leng is one of the beautiful roads that visitors must cross when conquering the Dong Van stone plateau. From afar, the pass looks like a thread stretched across the hills, creating a majestic landscape, and always challenging the drivers. Standing on the top of the pass, you will feel like you are standing among the clouds that obscure your view.

From the top of the pass, you can see the Nho Que River flowing like a beautiful silk strip, gently embracing the foot of the hill in a peaceful and serene way. Do you want to experience a Ha Giang trekking tour to see that scenery? Join Vietlook today, especially foreign tourists who are traveling Vietnam for the first time, come to Ha Giang to admire the beauty that nature has bestowed on Ha Giang.

Lung Cu Flagpole Ha Giang

An indispensable destination in any Ha Giang tour, Lung Cu is one of the beautiful sights in Ha Giang, the northernmost point of Vietnam.

The way to Lung Cu does not require you to overcome steep rocky passes. However, it is also a matter of pride when you leave your footprints here. You can enjoy the feeling of standing on the northernmost land of Vietnam and listen to the heroic historical stories of the nation.

Lung Cam Cultural Village, Ha Giang

A place that still preserves the cultural beauty of the ethnic groups in the mountainous region of Ha Giang. Coming here, you will admire the moss-roofed houses and ancient wooden houses stained with time.

The houses are simple and rustic but very unique and attractive. Especially when the flower season comes, Lung Cam is immersed in a dreamy natural landscape.

Hoang Su Phi terraced fields

The name is no longer strange in the Northwestern mountainous region. However, if you want to see with your own eyes the vast, majestic and incredibly beautiful terraced fields, you should come here once to feel the unique beauty that nature has bestowed on Ha Giang.

Hoang Su Phi terraced fields in the rainy season, the fields receive the water flowing down from the mountains, creating a rare majestic scene. In the harvest season, the golden rice fields will be a brilliant highlight on the hills and mountains.

Sung La Valley Ha Giang

The best place to admire the beauty of Ha Giang buckwheat flower fields. The H’Mong people in Sung La grow buckwheat and mustard flowers on the high hills, and corn and rice on the flat lands at the foot of the valley.

Each season, the hills are covered with a colorful coat of grass and flowers. In the summer, there is the green of the trees, in late autumn and early winter, there are purple buckwheat flowers, and in spring, the pink of cherry blossoms.

In the midst of this beautiful natural landscape, you will have the opportunity to admire the ancient houses that have been stained by time. It is a majestic, rustic and strangely peaceful scene. In addition, Ha Giang also has many attractive attractions such as: Bang Yen Minh Street, Cam Mountain, Noong Lake, ..

4. Things to note when traveling to Ha Giang

Ha Giang is a steep pass, so you need to walk a lot, so you should bring easy-to-move shoes (preferably sneakers) and neat clothes. The weather in Ha Giang is often cold at night and early morning, so prepare an extra jacket to keep your body warm.

Prepare a personal medicine bag to prevent common illnesses caused by cold weather such as fever reducers, stomach ache medicine, allergy cream and nasal spray.

Bring cash because there are very limited ATMs here.

Do not give money to children because it can create bad habits for them.

Prepare lip balm and moisturizing skin care products to avoid dry, cracked skin due to climate change.

If traveling by motorbike, bring extra fuel because there are not many gas stations. Also, bring a first aid kit and personal protective equipment (such as hand pads, pillows, flashlight, Ha Giang map).

Ha Giang has a unique beauty, this land is endowed by Mother Nature with countless unique and attractive landscapes. Ha Giang tourism is an interesting journey that many people love, especially young people who love backpacking. It can be said that the beautiful scenery of Ha Giang always captivates people with winding mountain passes, brilliant flower fields, adding a bright and brilliant look to the mountainous region of Northern Vietnam.
